description: Survey thresholds used as sensitivity brackets, not a calibrated union-selection probability.

Hyades_Schneider2022.limitations: Actual overlapping IR footprint, colour cuts, source vetting and BANYAN membership not reconstructed.

Hyades_Schneider2024.limitations: J=19.6 UHS sensitivity is not the completed spectroscopic census limit; colour and BANYAN cuts not modeled.

Pleiades_DANCe.limitations: Outer 5-deg circular field only approximates the irregular footprint. Not an injection-recovery completeness model.

wide_Gaia.limitations: Published membership algorithms, astrometric quality, contamination, and sky-dependent Gaia recovery not simulated. Radius 200pc contains almost all reference stars of current union, but is not a universal Gaia limit.

deep_Pleiades.treatment: Not extrapolated beyond its published patchy footprint; simulation focuses on .03-.08 Msun.

mock_luminosity: Existing Ember cluster isochrones at 125 and 650 Myr, respective Z=.01648 and .02307. Both atmosphere/cloud choices propagated. Bolometric measurement scatter .05 dex. No new stellar tracks.
mock_binaries: Bound pairs with separation <.01 pc and projected angular separation <1 arcsec are combined. Calibrated low-mass component light summed in flux. Bright >.25-Msun ordinary stellar companions hide low-mass members. Evolved companions not assigned a synthetic composite mass.
